ABOUT THE DEVICE

A powerful cyber device designed for reconnaissance, hacking, and security.

Leverage any software through linux alongside custom offensive and defensive tools to infiltrate systems, gather intel, secure networks and manipulate the hardware around you through wireless signals. Take control of the technology that shapes your world.

Enter Defence Mode

Defense mode lets you plug in your device as well as Ethernet and  automatically scans for threats, builds a secure digital WiFi with vpn,etc…

Secure Router

Turn your device into an enterprise grade, bulletproof network.
Firewall: Monitors traffic in real time, adaptively blocking threats instantly while keeping your network fast and responsive.
VPN: Encrypted tunnel protects your data, while letting you access the network locally or remotely with full security.
AD Blocker: Network-level DNS filtering blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains, keeping every device fast, clean, and secure.

RF Protection

Military-grade protection for the electronics in your space against interference.
Jamming Protection: Detects signal disruption early and keeps your devices connection steady, even in crowded or hostile environments.
Anti Spoofing: Uses cryptography to validate signals in real time, preventing fake GPS or cellular data from compromising your network.
